evidence: The final ratio of the cadmium-to-sulfur Auger signal intensities can be used to obtain the stoichiometry of the grown layer. In our case, the Cd/S ratio of 0.560 ± 0.006 matches the cadmium-to-sulfur Auger intensity ratio measured from a bulk CdS crystal, indicating that stoichiometric growth of CdS has been achieved.
